learning_outcomes.text: Can determine the element temperature and thermal resistance of an electronic component.
Can calculate the heat transferred by conduction for an electronic component.
Can calculate the heat transferred by natural and forced convection for an electronic system.

syllabus_topics: Air Cooling: Natural Convection and Thermal Radiation
One-Dimensional Heat Conduction in Planar Walls in Steady State
One-Dimensional Heat Conduction in Radial Systems in Steady State
Heat Transfer in Planar Walls with Heat Generation
Heat Transfer in Radial Systems with Heat Generation in Steady State (for distance learning)
One-Dimensional Heat Transfer in Extended Surfaces in Steady State
Time-Dependent Heat Transfer (Heisler and Gröber charts)
Heat Transfer by Radiation and examples
Introduction and Basic Concepts – Additional information
Ideal Gas State Equation – Additional information
Entropy (TdS relations, isentropic efficiencies of steady flow systems)
Thermal Management Strategies for Electronic Systems
Introduction: Relationship between Thermoelectricity – Thermodynamics – Heat Transfer
Thermoelectric Power Generation and Cooling Systems
Performance and Maximum Parameters of a Thermoelectric Generator Module
Example: Thermoelectric generator for exhaust heat recovery
Performance and Maximum Parameters of a Thermoelectric Cooler Module
Effective Material Properties of a Thermoelectric Module
assessment_rules: The overall assessment is based on 40% from semester work (Midterm Exam and Project/Design) and 60% from the Final Exam. The Midterm Exam and Project/Design each contribute 50% to the semester work score.
